title: Step 3 - Show the Sequence to the User with Animations and Sounds
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Flash the chosen button and play its sound, using search to find the techniques.

concepts.heading: Requirements
points: Select the button whose id matches randomChosenColour with the jQuery id selector: $("#" + randomChosenColour).
Animate a flash on it. Searching 'animate flash jQuery' leads to chaining fadeIn/fadeOut.
Play the matching sound with plain JS; search 'play sound javascript' leads to the Audio object.
The lecture deliberately asks the learner to research instead of giving the method names.

concepts.heading: Hints
points: Sound files are named after the colours (blue.mp3 etc.).

code_examples.caption: One possible approach

task.name: Show the next colour
task.goal: Button flashes and its sound plays on each call
steps: Select the button by id with jQuery
task.expected_result: Each nextSequence() call flashes one button with sound.
